chapter_title: Learning Experience Design and Software Technology
title: Platform Affordances and Constraints
description: AIL 606 textbook section on platform affordances and constraints: building an action-to-affordance map, distinguishing soft from hard constraints, reading signifiers, and verifying affordances against the live tool, with reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Distinguish a platform feature from an affordance or constraint relative to a named learner action.
Build an action-to-affordance map that classifies each platform response as affordance, soft constraint, or hard constraint, and re-run the classification across learner variability.
Choose among redesigning the action, changing the tool, or keeping the constraint on purpose when an action hits a hard constraint, with a stated learning reason.
Verify an affordance against the live tool rather than assuming it from a feature name or marketing copy.
